name: Filtrat
summary: Email verification, work-email finding from a name and domain or a LinkedIn URL, bulk list jobs, and email-to-LinkedIn lookup.

api_key.description: a Filtrat API key starting ak_ (API > API keys in the Filtrat app)

notes: Credits per call: verify 1 credit for a valid or invalid result (unknown is free, repeats within 180 days are free); finder 20 credits when found; LinkedIn-URL finder 10 for the profile plus 20; email-to-LinkedIn 30 for a verified profile.
resolve_catchall costs 5 extra credits and only when it reaches a clear answer.

Bulk flow: filtrat.bulk.create (JSON list, 1 to 100,000 emails, 5 requests a minute) returns a job; poll filtrat.bulk.get (60 per minute) until state is done, then read rows with filtrat.bulk.rows (paged) or filtrat.bulk.get with include=rows for jobs up to 10,000 rows. CSV-file upload is not in this entry.
The OpenAPI file at https://filtrat.io/openapi.json lists many more endpoints (monitors, lead lists, webhooks, AI columns) that this entry leaves out.

endpoints.name: Verify an email
endpoints.summary: Status (verified, invalid, catchall, risky, unknown), a confidence score and the domain's mail setup.

resolve_catchall.description: Resolve a catch-all result to verified or invalid (+5 credits, only on a clear answer).

skip_cache.description: Bypass the result cache and probe again; billable even if cached.

notes: A read over POST: it only checks an address.

endpoints.name: Find a work email from a name and domain
endpoints.summary: The person's work email from a name and a company domain or website.

full_name.description: Full name; use instead of, or with, first_name and last_name.

company_name.description: Company name, to correct a domain that does not receive mail.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL; enables a fallback when the main search fails.

skip_cache.description: Force a fresh search, bypassing cached results.

resolve_catchall.description: On a catch-all domain, resolve the address to a confirmed one (+5 credits, 25 in all). Off: the most likely address is returned unverified.

Idempotency-Key.description: Send the same key to retry safely: a repeat gets the first call's answer and is never charged twice.

notes: A read over POST: it only looks an email up. Answers within 175 seconds; not found is free.

endpoints.name: Find a work email from a LinkedIn URL
endpoints.summary: Reads the person's name and current company from LinkedIn, then finds their work email.

skip_cache.description: Force a fresh search, bypassing cached results.

resolve_catchall.description: On a catch-all domain, resolve the address to a confirmed one (+5 credits, 25 in all). Off: the most likely address is returned unverified.

notes: A read over POST. 10 credits for the profile (free if unreadable) plus 20 when an email is found. Rate limit: 100 requests a minute.

endpoints.name: Find a LinkedIn profile from a work email
endpoints.summary: linkedin_url, name, job title, company and location for a work email; verified is true when they work there now.

deep.description: Search a larger database too when the usual lookup cannot verify the person (priced differently, only when found).

details.description: Also return work_history and company details, at no extra charge.

fresh.description: Search again instead of using a kept answer from the last 30 days.

notes: A read over POST. Takes 5 to 20 seconds; not found and unverified answers are free.

endpoints.name: Start a bulk verification from a list
endpoints.summary: Verifies a list of emails in the background and returns the job.

emails.description: Emails to verify, 1 to 100,000; duplicates are removed.

auto_resolve_catchall.description: Resolve catch-all addresses during the job (+5 credits each resolved).

notes: A read over POST: it starts a job that only produces data and uses credits. Rate limit: 5 requests a minute. Poll filtrat.bulk.get with the job id.

endpoints.name: Get a bulk job
endpoints.summary: Status, progress and the count of each result; state is done when finished.

include.description: rows: once done, also return every row (jobs up to 10,000 rows).

endpoints.name: Get a bulk job's rows
endpoints.summary: One row per address, paginated and filterable by status.

page.description: Page number from 1; replaces offset when set.

status.description: Only rows with this status: verified, catchall, invalid, unknown, skipped or queued.

endpoints.name: Delete a bulk job
endpoints.summary: Deletes a verification job and its rows.
